```
def rewrite_type_variable(self, type_variable: Any) -> str:
    rendered = str(type_variable)
    tilde_prefix = "~"
    return (
        rendered[len(tilde_prefix) :]
        if rendered.startswith(tilde_prefix)
        else rendered
    )
```
